summary: Version 1 of the TikZ figure compiled and passed validation. The Critic scored it 0.93 with must_repair=false. It labels P, A, D, B, C, F, E at their measured points. Its strokes are the top P-A-D, right D-C, bottom B-F-C, vertical A-B, P-B, P-E-F and A-F. The Critic confirmed the topology matches the original.
